subject: environmental-science
title: Weather & Climate: UK Weather
welcome_lead: The UK is famous for grey skies, but our weather has surprises.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: UK climate, jet stream, seasons.
final_note: Always bring a coat — and sometimes sunglasses too.

concepts.def: Fast wind high in the atmosphere.

walkthroughs.body_html: The UK has a maritime climate — warm-ish winters and cool-ish summers thanks to the Atlantic ocean.
The jet stream is a fast wind 9 km up. When it dips south, we get cold and storms. When it sits north, we get warm dry weather.
Heatwaves and floods are becoming more common as climate change shifts UK weather.
